description: This file implements a client-side search functionality, including DOM manipulation, symbol sorting based on relevance and closeness, and event handling for user interactions.

methods.name: sortByClosestMatch
methods.description: Sorts a list of items based on relevance and closeness to the input query.

methods.name: clear_search_box
methods.description: Removes all child elements from the search box DOM element.

methods.name: update_search_box
methods.description: Updates the search box DOM with the current ordered symbols and adjusts padding.

methods.name: createCursorCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback function to handle keyboard navigation and selection within the search results.
